name: action1-mcp
description: Every Action1 endpoint, plus fleet-wide patch and vulnerability views across all your organizations.

action1_client_id.title: ACTION1_CLIENT_ID
action1_client_id.description: Client ID from the Action1 console's API Credentials page. With ACTION1_CLIENT_SECRET, the CLI mints a bearer token automatically. Create credentials at https://www.action1.com/api-documentation/.

action1_client_secret.title: ACTION1_CLIENT_SECRET
action1_client_secret.description: Client Secret paired with ACTION1_CLIENT_ID, from the Action1 console's API Credentials page.

action1_base_url.title: Action1 API base URL
action1_base_url.description: Base URL for the Action1 API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

action1_oauth2.title: Action1 bearer token
action1_oauth2.description: Pre-minted Action1 bearer token, used instead of ACTION1_CLIENT_ID + ACTION1_CLIENT_SECRET. Leave blank when you set the client ID and secret; the CLI mints and refreshes the token itself.

action1_org_id.title: Default organization ID
action1_org_id.description: Organization ID the fleet commands scope to by default (the --org flag overrides it). Leave blank to span every organization your credentials can see.
